missingness_policy: No source member is dropped. The absent IL17 program is unavailable, not an empty list or zero score. Later tissue mapping must retain the321-member denominator and report every unresolved member under a separately fixed policy; this source task does not authorize aliases, ambiguity collapse or zero-fill.

biological_interpretation_limits: UNSIGNED constitutive canonical pathway membership. Constitutive here means non-perturbation pathway membership, not ubiquitous or stable expression in all cells.
Not a proven fibrosis-response signature; not an epithelial IL17A perturbation; not fibrosis-specific or PSC-specific.
No member-level direction, treatment effect, perturbation dose or duration, differential-expression threshold, or experimental donor count is provided. None is invented.
The page's brief description is Extracellular matrix organization; its full description and source publication fields are empty. No further mechanistic claim is inferred.
MSigDB maps 340 original Ensembl gene IDs to 321 symbols/NCBI IDs. All original source rows are retained; duplicate mappings are not independent genes.

Identifier mappings and gene descriptions remain exactly as displayed by MSigDB after HTML entity decoding and whitespace normalization. No independent gene-identifier reconciliation, coordinate mapping, or liver/organoid coverage calculation was done.

Reactome release 95 and MSigDB 2026.1.Hs are pinned by this archived official page; the downloadable JSON filename independently pins MSigDB 2026.1.Hs. An Ensembl annotation release/genome build is not stated and is not inferred.
The live URL is mutable. These complete archived response bytes and SHA-256 values freeze the qualified source release.

programs.weighting_scope: Each official symbol has one equal unit of unsigned membership. Multiple published source Ensembl IDs do not increase that symbol weight. No response coefficients, effect weights, liver-value selection or scoring formula are supplied.

prospective_independence: Sources and complete membership fixed without reading liver expression, liver effects or the eight organoid interaction candidates for selection. Existing frozen organoid files remain unchanged.

transformations: Decode official HTML as ISO-8859-1 and JSON as UTF-8; decode HTML entities and collapse visible formatting whitespace only.
Parse all340 displayed source IDs and all321 official JSON symbols; fail on missing, repeated, malformed or conflicting source IDs and missing/extra official symbols.
Use321 official JSON symbols as members; retain every original source ID and row index in the CSV projection. Do not select among alternative source IDs.
Preserve published NCBI IDs as literal strings; no alias/current-annotation/locus reconciliation.
Give each official symbol membership_weight1 and directionUNSIGNED; this is not an upregulated response weight.
No tissue mapping, expression filtering, normalization, expression matching, scores, statistical tests or biological effect estimation.
